name: Nutshell
summary: Sales CRM with built-in email marketing for small teams. Manage your pipeline, automate follow-ups and run campaigns from one place, without enterprise complexity. Full API access is included on every plan.
best_for: small sales teams that want a friendly CRM with unlimited contacts and full API access on every tier, including the cheapest
skip_if: you need the marketing suite at scale — Marketing, Engagement, email and SMS are separate add-ons priced by volume, so price those before the seats
honest_knock: Full API access is included on every plan, so integrations are not the cost trap here — the add-ons are. Marketing at $49/mo and Engagement at $16/user/mo sit on top of the seat price, and email and SMS are billed by contact count and message volume, so the marketing side can outgrow the CRM itself. SSO and SQL data access are Enterprise-only.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month on annual billing ($19 billed monthly)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-16 on nutshell.com/pricing, both billing toggles) Five CRM tiers, per user a month: Foundation $13 on annual billing or $19 billed monthly, Growth $25 or $32, Pro $42 or $49, Business $59 or $67, and Enterprise $79 or $89. The page's 'Save 15%' badge fits Pro alone: on its own figures annual billing saves 31.6% on Foundation ($6 of $19), 21.9% on Growth, 14.3% on Pro, 11.9% on Business and 11.2% on Enterprise. Unlimited contacts and full API access come with every tier, which is the unusual part — most CRMs ration one or both — though Foundation is capped at 100 open leads. Two paid extensions sit alongside: Marketing from $49 a month and Engagement from $16 per user a month. The trial is 14 days without a card, and plan changes and cancellations take effect at the next billing cycle.
